determinism.identity: Evidence content identity is lowercase SHA-256 of complete canonical serialized bytes, including outcome, diagnostics, and non-semantic extensions, while evidence_id is a stable logical identifier
determinism.ordering: payloads, dependencies, diagnostics, hashes, features, dependency edges, outcome references, dimensions, and truncation IDs sort and deduplicate by their declared stable identity
determinism.replay: basis_sha256 covers evidence ID, subject, format, producer, dependencies, and generation fields other than itself; deterministic mode forbids a seed and seeded mode requires one exact nonnegative seed
determinism.serialization: UTF-8 canonical JSON uses NFC strings, sorted mapping keys, compact separators, ASCII escapes, bounded integers, no floats, and exactly one trailing newline

effects.filesystem: none during construction, validation, replay-identity calculation, serialization, or content identity calculation; referenced payload and dependency bytes are not opened implicitly
effects.mutation: constructed values are immutable and caller-owned mutable objects are never retained by alias
effects.process: none; resource and producer values report external execution but validation launches, signals, and terminates no process
effects.solver: none; producer claims are represented structurally and no backend is invoked

ensures: Evidence contains one stable logical ID, exact mathematical subject, versioned format, producer provenance, closed payload registry, acyclic dependency closure, generation replay identity, terminal resource snapshot, explicit production outcome, complete diagnostics, and namespaced non-semantic extensions.
Evidence records producer artifacts only: produced means canonical payload bytes were retained and never means proved, refuted, valid, checker-attested, externally verified, or mathematically true.

One produced envelope binds exactly one nonempty primary payload and all retained payload IDs; auxiliary payloads remain explicit and content aliases or duplicate role-plus-content identities fail closed.

Format version, numeric major and minor, minimum reader minor, schema identity, canonicalization algorithm, and required feature set agree exactly; unsupported major versions and version-confusion mutations fail closed.

Dependency nodes sort by stable ID, bind exact Evidence byte hashes and relations, resolve every edge inside the declared closure, reject self-reference and cycles, and do not infer validity from graph reachability.

Generation identity covers evidence ID, subject, format, producer, dependency closure, deterministic or explicitly seeded algorithm, configuration, and canonical subject input while excluding produced observations and diagnostics.

Unsupported, incomplete, cancelled, exhausted, truncated, and error outcomes remain explicit, bind every diagnostic, and cannot be serialized or interpreted as produced or independently verified evidence.
Cancellation, exhaustion, and truncation match the ResourceBudget terminal outcome exactly; every other Evidence outcome requires a completed ledger and cannot hide a resource interruption.

Canonical serialization and SHA-256 identity are reproducible without clock origin, process ID, checkout path, random values outside an explicit seed, implicit backend identity, or mutable caller state.

epistemics.cancelled: generation observed an identified cancellation and no successful completion or mathematical verdict is implied
epistemics.error: producer generation failed under a completed resource ledger and retained error diagnostics without creating verified authority
epistemics.exhausted: one or more exact budget dimensions lacked capacity and partial bytes have no verified authority
epistemics.incomplete: some producer work may be retained but the declared Evidence object is not a complete produced artifact
epistemics.invalid: one or more contract invariants fail and no Evidence content identity or epistemic authority is returned
epistemics.mathematical_truth: never inferred from Evidence structure, production, producer labels, format names, payload presence, dependency closure, or successful generation
epistemics.produced: the producer retained the complete declared payload set under a completed budget and says nothing about independent checking or truth
epistemics.truncated: one or more identified outputs were omitted under explicit ResourceBudget truncation and the retained payload subset is exact
epistemics.unsupported: the producer cannot emit the required format or feature set and the explicit reason and diagnostic are retained
epistemics.valid: all representation, canonicalization, identity, reference, dependency, replay, diagnostic, outcome, and budget invariants pass without proving referenced bytes, producer honesty, certificate validity, or mathematical truth

invariants: The normative schema is docs/contracts/schemas/evidence-v1.schema.json=4f1d0a4438812bdd7b204d0d0fe0098ff06cc274eb2e4ed7fa66a3f3a76b426f and unknown fields fail closed at every object boundary.

Evidence, producer, payload, dependency, and diagnostic IDs share one collision-free envelope namespace; payloads, dependencies, diagnostics, set-valued hashes, features, edges, outcome references, dimensions, and truncation IDs use their declared canonical order.

Evidence format major is exactly 1, semantic version major and minor equal the numeric compatibility fields, minimum reader minor does not exceed the writer minor, and feature identifiers are sorted reverse-DNS names.
The primary payload reference is null exactly when no primary payload exists; a produced outcome requires one nonempty primary payload and binds every payload once.
Dependency Evidence IDs and content hashes do not repeat, the current Evidence ID is absent from the dependency set, every dependency edge resolves, and depth-first closure is acyclic.

Deterministic generation has no seed, seeded generation has one exact nonnegative seed, generation configuration equals producer configuration, input identity equals canonical subject identity, and basis_sha256 matches the normative replay basis.

The schema contains no checker, verdict, authority, trust promotion, or self-attestation field; extensions cannot override subject, payload, producer, format, replay, budget, outcome, identity, or mathematical authority.

Every diagnostic ID and related payload resolves exactly, the outcome binds all diagnostics, non-produced outcomes retain a diagnostic, error retains error severity, and produced evidence hides no error diagnostic.
Cancelled, exhausted, and truncated outcomes match the budget outcome; unsupported, incomplete, produced, and error require a completed budget outcome.

Canonical input contains at most 67108864 bytes, 4000000 visited values, 64 nesting levels, 100000 envelope entities and items per array, and 1048576 code points per string; validation is bounded by 30 seconds.
The complete canonical Evidence bytes, including outcomes, diagnostics, and non-semantic extensions, have one lowercase SHA-256 content identity while evidence_id remains a stable logical identifier.
raises: EvidenceCertificateValidationError with kind schema for unknown or missing fields, malformed tagged unions, invalid enums, duplicate JSON keys, invalid scalar types, or noncanonical extension values.
EvidenceCertificateValidationError with kind canonical, compatibility, identity, reference, dependency, replay, diagnostic, outcome, or budget for the corresponding failed invariant.
MemoryError, KeyboardInterrupt, and SystemExit are never converted into produced, verified, valid, completed, or otherwise successful evidence.
requires: Input is a schema-exact mathhead.evidence.v1 object governed by docs/contracts/schemas/evidence-v1.schema.json=4f1d0a4438812bdd7b204d0d0fe0098ff06cc274eb2e4ed7fa66a3f3a76b426f.

The subject binds one goal, obligation, claim, or result to exact statement, ProblemIR, TheoryContext, selected-reading, assumption, and obligation identities; sorted assumption and obligation sets contain no aliases.

The producer declares a producer, solver, heuristic, or external role and exact contract, implementation, configuration, version, and environment identities without any checker verdict or verified-authority field.

Every retained payload and dependency is content-addressed with exact byte size, format, relation, and identity; referenced bytes are independently obtained and SHA-256 checked before a consumer interprets them.

All strings are Unicode NFC without NUL, JSON contains no floats, integers stay in the portable exact range, root extensions use reverse-DNS namespaces, nested extension keys use lowercase snake case, and declared hard ceilings are satisfied.
